title: IRS Notice Response Navigator
tagline: The notice number chooses the workflow; urgency does not choose the evidence.

cards: The taxpayer sees a balance, correction, or evidence request.
The correct document and response channel depend on the notice.
Over-collection increases exposure without improving routing.
The response advances without deciding the tax position.

story.headline: The tax notice answered with the wrong evidence
beats: A taxpayer receives a time-sensitive notice.
The account already holds most of the supporting records.
A generic checklist duplicates sensitive data and may miss the actual deadline.
The navigator maps the notice, requests one item, and preserves professional review.
